It is used unchanged, so A and B sessions are recorded and analyzed under one protocol hash. rules: Each session needs its own fresh, successful candidate B calibration (27 anchors: ordinary, higher, lower).
The official entries are exactly protocol 1.0.0's collection_plan.official entries for calibration_b_three_pass_positions.

The technical pilot is never official: protocol 1.0.0 treats every participant ID starting with PILOT as a technical pilot, imported only into data/pilot/. Protocol 1.0.0 lists PILOT01 / T1 for candidate A; candidate B's pilot uses the distinct label TB1.
The B app's setup screen offers exactly these three sessions, with participant, label and block order fixed by the entry, and no free-text identifiers.
Head positions and numerical rules, schedule, thresholds and acceptance criteria are those of protocol 1.0.0; nothing here changes them.
